typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*N, V, Lizzy, Doll, Thad and Uzi were in different areas in the bunker, Doll was with V in the kitchen. N and Uzi were cuddling each other on the couch in the living room area, Lizzy and Thad were talking to each other in their room*

Lizzy: "So.. Thad.. Anything new to do besides just sit around?.." *She said sitting up on her side of the bed*

Thad: "No.. No not really.. I mean.. I guess we could go hunting.." *He looked down for a moment* "But I'm scared that one of us would get infected..."

*In the living room*

Uzi: *She laid her head on N's chest as she listened to music on her phone*

N: *He pets Uzi gently, Making sure she felt comfortable*

*In the kitchen*

V: *She is in the kitchen, washing the dishes* "Ugh, for fuck sake, why am I the one that has to do this??"

Doll: *She walks into the kitchen and looks at V* "Могу ли я помочь?" (Can I help?)
typesense:top-rated.name: MD love virus
typesense:top-rated.title: This one isn’t annoying
